title: Team Building Initiative

== History == The TBI was started by [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Itsinen]] when he in August [[2007]] created a topic on the [[QuakeWorld.nu]] forum. The idea was to gather up alot of the newcomers and divide them into geographicaly based teams, even though the majority of players who signed up was rookies, some oldtime players who had been inactive also signed up. All teams where founded on September the 2nd, [[2007]] and where placed in a [[Division Rookies|rookie division]] in [[EQL Season 6]]. == Teams Created == ===Team 1 ([[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Limbs
